profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Azure & .NET | Cloud Architecture • Distributed Systems • APIs • React | CI/CD • GitHub Actions • Entra ID
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer specializing in cloud-native application development with .NET and Microsoft Azure. I build and modernize production systems across backend services, APIs, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, identity, and frontend applications.

At Evention, I’ve contributed across multiple products and platform initiatives, giving me broad experience navigating complex systems and understanding how applications, infrastructure, security, and deployment pipelines fit together.

My work spans .NET APIs, Azure services, event-driven workflows, React applications, Microsoft Entra ID, cloud security, private networking, managed identities, and automated delivery pipelines with GitHub Actions and Infrastructure as Code.

I work primarily with C#, .NET, Azure, Azure Functions, App Service, API Management, Service Bus, React, TypeScript, SQL, Entra ID, GitHub Actions, Bicep, and modern CI/CD practices.

Beyond implementation, I’m increasingly focused on the engineering decisions behind the systems I build —architecture, reliability, security, maintainability, developer experience, and how technical decisions affect multiple teams and products.

I’m particularly interested in solving complex engineering problems involving cloud platforms, distributed systems, backend services, developer platforms, and modern .NET/Azure architecture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build and modernize cloud-based financial and operational software across Evention’s product ecosystem, working across backend services, APIs, cloud infrastructure, security, identity, CI/CD, and frontend applications.

• Engineer and modernize applications across 7+ products and platform initiatives using C#, .NET, React, SQL, and Microsoft Azure.

• Design and contribute to 10+ APIs, Azure Functions, services, and significant endpoints supporting integrations and event-driven workflows.

• Strengthen security across ~5 cloud applications and services using managed identities, Private Endpoints, private networking, and Microsoft Entra ID authentication and authorization.

• Build and maintain 7 CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, OIDC, and Bicep, supporting application and infrastructure delivery across 5 environments from development through production.

• Modernize identity and access using Entra ID, OAuth/OIDC, MSAL, application roles, and Azure App Service authentication across APIs and React applications.

• Develop event-driven solutions with Azure Service Bus and Azure Functions to support reliable asynchronous processing and decoupled application components.

• Collaborate across ~3 engineering teams representing ~19 engineers to troubleshoot cross-system issues, coordinate dependencies, and deliver solutions spanning applications, infrastructure, security, and deployment.
positions.insights: Azure Functions, Microsoft Azure and +32 skills

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
• Built an application that automated customer venue-data migration from a legacy system into the enterprise platform, reducing manual effort and accelerating the migration process.

• Developed full-stack software solutions from design specifications and collaborated with an Agile team to scope, prioritize, and deliver feature requests.

• Modernized legacy AngularJS application functionality to Angular 8, improving maintainability and alignment with the application’s current front-end architecture.
positions.insights: Microsoft Azure, Software Development and +10 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed client-specific software modules by translating business requirements and process workflows into maintainable application solutions.

• Redesigned SharePoint-hosted .NET applications as standalone applications, reducing dependency on SharePoint and preventing application outages associated with the hosting environment.

• Automated validation of borrowers’ Servicemembers Civil Relief Act (SCRA) status, eliminating reliance on a third-party processing service and streamlining an existing business process.

positions.title: Sharepoint Consultant
positions.description:
• Developed SharePoint business solutions including sites, custom workflows, permissions, content, and user-targeted page customizations.

• Built custom SharePoint web parts using .NET to support business-specific workflows and application requirements.
